Chapter 298: Chapter 6 Lucky Break (Please Subscribe)_3

Chapter 298: Chapter 6 Lucky Break (Please Subscribe)_3

Because they all belonged to the Black Abyss clan, even if they set up fail-safes, these were intended for combating other different species. The inheritance they left behind was naturally meant to fall into the hands of their own kind.

Therefore, the few members of the Black Abyss clan only needed to reveal their own Black Abyss aura to smoothly acquire everything.

But the Human Race…

The Human Race was in an adversarial relationship with the Black Abyss clan—if they were to enter, they would certainly trigger the various contingencies left behind by the space’s Opener.

A space carved out by a suspected Eighth-Layer powerhouse with contingencies left behind could retain a certain level of potency even after hundreds of thousands of years.

“You go in first.”

...

The leading member of the Black Abyss clan glanced at the one beside him and spoke indifferently.

“Captain Wei Qing, I am not the strongest. Entering a space gateway left by such a level might not be a good idea…”

This member of the Black Abyss clan, named Ran Fen, looked cautiously at Captain Wei Qing and tentatively spoke.

Although the inheritance left by a suspected Eighth-Layer powerhouse greatly tempted him, the prerequisite was to be alive to claim it.

The first one to enter would certainly face the greatest risk.

“Ran Fen, although your strength isn’t great, your life-saving techniques are strong. If you go in, according to the rules we agreed upon beforehand, you’ll get thirty percent of all the loots.”

Another member of the Black Abyss clan spoke up.

“Alright.”

“Captain Wei Qing, you heard that.”

Ran Fen clenched his teeth—it was mainly that he didn’t have much of a choice. If he didn’t enter, Captain Wei Qing would still ‘invite’ him in.

A moment later.

Captain Wei Qing’s brow furrowed.

“Dead.”

Captain Wei Qing declared.

Not long after Ran Fen entered, the communication with him was completely severed, which meant death.

“With Ran Fen’s survival ability, even Seventh-Rank powerhouses shouldn’t be able to kill him in a short time, right?” The rest of the Black Abyss clan powerhouses suddenly felt troubled.

“This also shows that the space gateway here has even greater value.”

Captain Wei Qing spoke.

They had come across this place by chance.

They only discovered the space gateway while planning to rest in this valley.

The gateway’s aura was concealed; it simply couldn’t be detected by perceptual methods. You could only find something amiss by approaching within a certain distance.

So for many years, this space gateway remained undiscovered.

Battlefield C24763 was too vast, with a diameter of 0.2 light-years, an unknown multiple of a normal planet’s size.

“You guys?”

Captain Wei Qing swept a glance at the remaining members of the Black Abyss clan.

“Captain Wei Qing, even Ran Fen died. Entering would mean certain death for us too… it’s not necessary,” the several Black Abyss clan powerhouses immediately grew nervous.

“That is true.”

Captain Wei Qing thought for a while.

He did not really mind the life or death of the other Black Abyss members.

But the prerequisite was obtaining the inheritance from inside the space gateway.

“Would it require reporting back to the clan?”

Captain Wei Qing felt somewhat unwilling in his heart.

With the strength of the Heiyuan clan, if they dispatched a powerhouse, they would definitely be able to extract all the treasures and inheritance from inside the space gateway.

But by doing that, Captain Wei Qing could only receive a small share.

The lion’s share would certainly fall to the clan.

“Hm?”

Just at that moment.

Captain Wei Qing seemed to sense something and looked up in a certain direction.

A pitch-black spaceship was flying towards them at this moment.

“Is it a Human Race Evolver?”

Captain Wei Qing immediately made a judgment. It couldn’t be helped, the Heiyuan clan’s technology was lacking, incapable of building ships that could perform wormhole shuttles.

Therefore, the Heiyuan clan did not rely on spaceships for travel.

“The Human Race?”

“Captain Wei Qing, we can capture this Human Race and then force him into the space gateway.”

“He is from the Human Race, and the one who left behind this space gateway is also from the Human Race.”

“If a Human enters, he probably won’t encounter the kill switches. When he gets all the inheritance and treasures, we just take them from him…”

One of the Black Abyss clan powerhouses immediately spoke.

Upon hearing this, the rest of the Black Abyss clan powerhouses immediately agreed.

That way, they didn’t need to venture inside themselves, nor was there any need to report back to the tribe and give away a large share.

Captain Wei Qing’s eyes lit up, he nodded and said, “Good idea.”

Then he looked up at the position of the pitch-black spaceship, a smile appearing on his face.

“Lucky.”
